items.title: Logitech's Yeti 2 brings the 17-year-old USB mic into the modern age

items.lede: The original Blue Yeti has been one of the most recognizable go-to USB microphones for content creators since it launched in 2009, and now it finally has a successor. Launching today under Logitech G, the Blue Yeti 2 adds some modern upgrades, including an interactive LED display, AI de-noising, and a proximity based voice sensor […]
items.title: Logitech’s new Blue Yeti 2 mic adjusts itself to where you are
